# Deploy window

## Decision

Deploys happen on Tuesdays before noon; never on Fridays.

## Context

Three earlier memories named other windows; this page corrects all of them.

## Alternatives considered

Friday evening deploys.

## Consequences

A failed deploy has the rest of the week to be fixed.
